info.name: PAWEAR V2 — Backend + Admin + SSR
info.description: Three synchronized phases. Enable the Postman cookie jar. Set private credentials locally, never share/export them. Log in as admin before catalog writes, then as customer before checkout. Successful creates capture IDs automatically. Requests that delete/deactivate or complete mock payments are manual, not an unattended production runner.
